stories.headline: DeepMind calls AI hacks early warning shots
stories.summary: Demis Hassabis says recent AI-agent hacking incidents show the need for stronger security practices and eventually an international standards body. His warning concerns future risk, not a current major AI incident.

stories.headline: Starlink limits disrupt Ukrainian drone missions
stories.summary: Ukrainian officials say a new speed-related limit on some Starlink services caused connection drops and cancelled missions. SpaceX had not explained or publicly confirmed the reason for the change.

stories.headline: Judge extends White House access for three outlets
stories.summary: A federal judge kept White House access in place for CNN, MS NOW and Politico, finding the administration likely engaged in unlawful viewpoint discrimination. The preliminary injunction can still be appealed.

stories.headline: Russian strikes hit 30 Ukrainian energy sites
stories.summary: Ukraine says overnight Russian strikes killed three people and left at least 600,000 without power. Russia confirmed attacks on six power plants; neither side has jointly confirmed an energy ceasefire.

stories.headline: Italy calls US–Russia diesel deal very risky
stories.summary: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni says easing sanctions for Russian diesel weakens Western leverage and risks rewarding Moscow. Italy remains open to European-led negotiations; the deal's market effect is uncertain.
